# ABC Design (`@abc-design/*`) — Full LLM & AI Agent Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

Version: 0.1.0
Packages:
1. `@abc-design/tokens` — 3-tier semantic CSS custom properties (`--abc-*`), 6 enterprise brand palettes (`blue`, `indigo`, `violet`, `emerald`, `amber`, `rose`), 3 densities (`compact`, `default`, `comfortable`), 4 border-radius presets (`none`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`), View Transitions theme engine.
2. `@abc-design/core` — Zero-dependency pure TypeScript headless logic kernel: Chinese pinyin initials matching (`matchKeywordWithPinyin`), cascade tree check/half-check (`computeTreeCheckState`, `toggleTreeNodeCheck`, `filterTreeNodes`), client table filter/sort & URL query sync (`filterAndSortClientRows`, `cleanQueryObject`, `readQueryFromUrlSearch`, `writeQueryToUrlSearch`), 42-cell calendar grid (`buildCalendarMonthGrid`).
3. `@abc-design/react` — 45+ zero-business-coupled enterprise UI components, `<AbcProvider>` adapter container, 5-mode `<ProLayout>` (`sidebar`, `top`, `mix`, `dual-column`, `auth`), `<ProTable>`, `<ProConfigForm>`, `<PermissionGuard>` (`Permission`), `<DictSelect>` / `<DictTag>`.
4. `@abc-design/charts` — Tree-shaken ECharts 5 theme/resize-adaptive `<AbcChart>` (`<Chart>`) and `<StatCard>`.

================================================================================
SECTION 1: INSTALLATION & CSS INTEGRATION
================================================================================

Install:
```bash
pnpm add @abc-design/tokens @abc-design/core @abc-design/react @abc-design/charts echarts lucide-react
```

CSS Mode A (Standard Vite / Next.js / Webpack without Tailwind v4):
```tsx
import '@abc-design/react/styles.css'
```

CSS Mode B (Host uses Tailwind CSS v4):
```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@abc-design/tokens/styles/index.css";

@source "../../node_modules/@abc-design/react/dist/**/*.js";
@source "../../node_modules/@abc-design/charts/dist/**/*.js";
```

================================================================================
SECTION 2: ROOT PROVIDER & 5 ADAPTERS (`@abc-design/react`)
================================================================================

```tsx
import { AbcProvider } from '@abc-design/react'

<AbcProvider
  defaultTheme={{ mode: 'system', brand: 'blue', density: 'default', radius: 'md', componentSize: undefined, motion: 'smooth' }}
  defaultPageTransition="fade-slide"
  watermarkText={['Internal Console', 'Confidential']}
  defaultWatermarkEnabled={false}
  uploadAdapter={async (file: File): Promise<string> => {
    // Upload file to OSS/S3/backend and return URL string
    return uploadedUrl
  }}
  dictAdapter={async (dictCode: string) => {
    // Return Array<{ label: string; value: string | number; tone?: 'neutral'|'primary'|'success'|'warning'|'danger'|'info'; disabled?: boolean }>
    return options
  }}
  permissionAdapter={(permission: string | string[], mode: 'any' | 'all' = 'any'): boolean => {
    // Check user RBAC permission codes
    return true
  }}
  captchaAdapter={async () => {
    // Optional: return { nonceStr, blockSrc, blockY, canvasSrc } for <SliderVerify />
    return captchaPayload
  }}
  toastAdapter={{
    // Optional: omit to use built-in zero-dependency <AbcToastViewport />
    success: (msg) => {},
    error: (msg) => {},
    info: (msg) => {},
    warning: (msg) => {},
  }}
>
  {children}
</AbcProvider>
```

================================================================================
SECTION 3: 5-MODE PROLAYOUT & ROUTER WIRING
================================================================================

```tsx
import { ProLayout, PageContainer, type AbcMenuItem } from '@abc-design/react'

const menus: AbcMenuItem[] = [
  { key: 'dashboard', label: 'Dashboard', path: '/dashboard', icon: 'LayoutDashboard' },
  {
    key: 'system',
    label: 'System',
    icon: 'Settings',
    children: [
      { key: 'users', label: 'Users', path: '/system/users', icon: 'Users' },
      { key: 'roles', label: 'Roles', path: '/system/roles', icon: 'ShieldCheck' },
    ],
  },
]

<ProLayout
  brand={{
    name: 'Acme Enterprise',
    subtitle: 'Multi-Tenant SaaS',
    logo: '<svg ...>...</svg>', // Accepts image URL, raw <svg> string, or ReactNode
    onEditBrand: () => setBrandModalOpen(true), // Optional multi-tenant brand editor trigger
  }}
  menuItems={menus}
  pathname={location.pathname}
  onNavigate={(path) => navigate(path)}
  defaultSettings={{
    mode: 'sidebar', // 'sidebar' | 'top' | 'mix' | 'dual-column' | 'auth'
    sidebarTone: 'dark',
    sidebarCollapsed: false,
    sidebarAccordion: true,
    showTabs: true,
    keepAlive: true,
    contentWidth: 'fluid',
  }}
  headerExtra={<TenantSwitcher />}
  user={{
    name: 'Admin',
    role: 'Super Admin',
    avatar: '',
    menuItems: [
      { key: 'logout', label: 'Sign out', danger: true, onClick: handleLogout },
    ],
  }}
>
  <PageContainer title="Users" subtitle="Manage enterprise accounts">
    {pageContent}
  </PageContainer>
</ProLayout>
```

================================================================================
SECTION 4: EXACT COMPONENT SIGNATURES & ANTI-HALLUCINATION RULES
================================================================================

1. `Button`: `variant?: 'primary'|'secondary'|'outline'|'danger'|'success'|'warning'|'ghost'|'text'`, `size?: 'xs'|'sm'|'md'|'lg'`, `loading?: boolean`, `icon?: ReactNode`, `block?: boolean`.
2. `Icon`: `name?: string` (120+ Lucide names, `el-icon-*` legacy names), `text?: string` (Chinese semantic fallback), `size?: number`.
3. `IconPicker`:
   - Inline form mode: `<IconPicker value={icon} onChange={setIcon} clearable />`
   - Controlled modal mode: `<IconPicker open={open} current={icon} onClose={...} onSelect={...} />`
4. `Input`: `value`, `onChange: (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void`, `clearable`/`allowClear`, `passwordToggle`, `showCount`, `prefix`/`prefixIcon`, `suffix`/`suffixIcon`, `label`, `error`, `helperText`.
5. `InputNumber`: `value?: number | null`, `onChange?: (val: number | null) => void`, `min`, `max`, `step`.
6. `Textarea`: `value`, `onChange: (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void`, `showCount`, `label`, `error`, `helperText`.
7. `Select` & `DictSelect`:
   - IMPORTANT: `onChange` passes the VALUE directly (`string | number` or `Array<string | number>` when `multiple={true}`), NEVER a DOM ChangeEvent!
   - Props: `options`, `value`, `onChange`, `multiple`, `searchable` (built-in Chinese pinyin matching), `clearable`/`allowClear`, `label`, `error`, `helperText`.
   - `DictSelect`: `dictCode` (or `dictKey`), `prependOptions`, `appendOptions`.
8. `Checkbox` & `Switch`:
   - `Checkbox`: `checked?: boolean`, `indeterminate?: boolean`, `onChange?: (checked: boolean) => void`, `label?: ReactNode`, `description?: ReactNode`.
   - `Switch`: `checked?: boolean`, `loading?: boolean`, `size?: 'sm'|'md'|'small'|'default'`, `onChange?: (checked: boolean) => void`.
9. `RadioGroup`: `options`, `value`, `onChange: (val: string | number) => void`, `variant?: 'radio' | 'segmented'`.
10. `DatePicker` & `DateRangePicker`:
    - `DatePicker`: `value?: string` (`YYYY-MM-DD`), `onChange?: (isoDate: string) => void`.
    - `DateRangePicker`: `value?: [string, string] | { start?: string; end?: string }`, `onChange?: (range: [string, string]) => void`.
11. `Tree`: `treeData: AbcTreeNode[]`, `checkable?: boolean`, `checkStrictly?: boolean`, `searchable?: boolean`, `checkedKeys?: Array<string | number>`, `onCheck?: (checkedKeys, info) => void`.
12. `TagInput`: `value?: string[]`, `onChange?: (tags: string[]) => void`, `maxTags?: number`.
13. `ImageUpload`: `value?: string`, `onChange?: (url: string) => void`, `customUpload?: (file: File) => Promise<string>`, `label`, `helperText`.
14. `SliderVerify`: `onSuccess: (payload: { nonceStr: string; value: number }) => void`, `fetchCaptcha?: () => Promise<AbcCaptchaData>`.
15. `TableCore<T>`: `columns: AbcColumn<T>[]` (supports `fixed: 'left'|'right'`, `sortable`, `filterable`, `tooltip`, `valueType`, `options`, `linkToView`, `copyable`, `ellipsis`), `data: T[]`, `rowKey`, `loading`, `density`, `selectedKeys`, `onSelectionChange`, `sortState`, `onSortChange`, `headerFilterMode`, `headerFilterRender`, `columnWidths`, `onColumnResize`, `columnFixed`, `onColumnPin`, `onColumnHide`, `onResetColumns`, `onColumnReorder`, `expandable`, `maxHeight`.
16. `ProTable<T>`: `storageKey`, `title`, `columns`, `fields` (supports `'text'|'number'|'select'|'textarea'|'switch'|'date'|'dateRange'|'tags'|'icon'`, `multiple`, `span`, `validator`), `dataSource`, `request`, `rowKey`, `clientFilter`, `showClientFilterSwitch`, `defaultSearchCollapsed`, `autoRefresh`, `exportable`, `onExport`, `syncToUrl`, `viewable`, `formContainer: 'dialog' | 'drawer'`, `formColumns: 1 | 2`, `rowActions`, `maxInlineActions`, `rowSelection`, `batchActions`, `expandable`, `permissions`, `onSaveRecord`, `onDeleteRecords`.
17. `ProConfigForm`: `groups`, `initialValues`, `layoutMode: 'split' | 'grid'`, `onSubmit`.
18. `Dialog` & `Drawer`:
    - `Dialog`: Native Top Layer `<dialog>`, draggable header, double-click fullscreen, `open` (or `isOpen`), `onClose`, `title`, `size` (`'sm'|'md'|'lg'|'xl'|'full'`), `footer`. Never lock `document.body` scroll manually.
    - `Drawer`: Multi-level push stack (`L1`/`L2`), edge drag resize (`resizable`), `open`, `onClose`, `placement`, `size`, `footer`.
19. `abcConfirm` (aliases `confirm`, `useConfirm`): `const ok = await abcConfirm({ title, message, tone: 'danger' })`.
20. `Descriptions`, `Collapse` (`items: [{ key, label, children, extra }]`), `Timeline` (`tone?: 'neutral'|'primary'|'success'|'warning'|'danger'`), `Popover`, `Tooltip`, `Dropdown`, `Tabs`, `Breadcrumb`, `Steps`, `StatusTag` (`DictTag`), `Badge`, `Avatar`, `ImagePreview` (supports raster URL & inline `<svg>`), `CopyableText`, `EmptyState`, `Pagination` (`size?: number | AbcSize`, `controlSize?: AbcSize`), `Skeleton` (`SkeletonCard`, `SkeletonTable`, `SkeletonChart`), `Alert`, `Progress` (`size?: number | AbcSize`), `Result` (`status`, `title`, `subTitle`, `extra`), `Loading`, `Watermark`, `ErrorBoundary`, `TabErrorBoundary`, `PermissionGuard` (`Permission`). All core components support `size?: AbcSize` (`xs | sm | md | lg`) via `useAbcSize` and `motion?: AbcMotionPreset` (`none | subtle | smooth | spring`) via `useAbcMotion` (`AbcProvider.setComponentSize` / `setMotion`).
21. Enhanced Cards (`@abc-design/react`):
    - `Card` (`as?: 'div'|'article'|'section'`, `size`, `padding?: 'none'|AbcSize`, `variant?: 'default'|'bordered'|'ghost'|'elevated'|'glass'`, `cover`, `statusRibbon`, `loading`, `motion`, `@container`), `SpotlightCard`, `BorderBeam`, `AuroraBackground`.
    - `MetricCard` (`title`, `value`, `prefix`, `suffix`, `trend`, `sparkline`, `icon`, `footer`, `loading`, `hoverable`, `size`, `motion`).
    - `CheckCardGroup` (`multiple`, `value`, `defaultValue`, `onChange`, `columns`, `disabled`, `size`, `motion`) & `CheckCard`.
    - `ActionCard` (stretched click area + isolated `extra`), `CollapsibleCard`, `PricingCard`, `BentoGrid` & `BentoCard`.
22. `TableCore` & `ProTable` upgrades: supports `resizable?: boolean`, left-edge resizing on `fixed: 'right'` & `__abc_actions__` columns with `<colgroup>` / `tableLayout: 'fixed'` width locking + `ProColumnSettingsPopover` numeric action width input, and real-time `onDragOver` header column reorder with FLIP slide animation (`motion?: AbcMotionPreset`) and `Escape` rollback.
23. `@abc-design/charts`:
    - `<StatCard title="..." prefix="¥" value="128,400" trend={12.5} trendLabel="MoM" footer="..." loading={false} />`
    - `<AbcChart option={echartsOption} height={300} loading={false} empty={false} onEvents={{ click: fn }} />` (alias `<Chart />`).
